select b.*, u.name as assign_name from business b left join user u on b.user_id = u.id
and b.id = #{businessQueryDto.businessId}
and b.name like concat('%', #{businessQueryDto.name}, '%')
and b.phone like concat('%', #{businessQueryDto.phone}, '%')
and b.status = #{businessQueryDto.status}
and u.name like concat('%', #{businessQueryDto.assignName}, '%')
order by b.update_time desc

select count(1) as business_total, count(if(status = 1, 1, null)) as business_wait_allot, count(if(status = 2, 1, null)) as business_wait_follow, count(if(status = 3, 1, null)) as business_following, count(if(status = 4, 1, null)) as business_false, count(if(status = 5, 1, null)) as business_convert_customer from business;
